label: AlphaESS Dashboard (FlowFuse Dashboard 2.0)
info:
Bilingual (EN/DE) FlowFuse Dashboard 2.0 for @impact0815/node-red-contrib-alphaess-modbus.

SETUP
1. Move the three link-out nodes "AlphaESS → Dashboard …" into the tab of your AlphaESS node (Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V) and connect: output 1 → Data, output 2 → Alarm, output 3 → Response.
2. Move the link-in node "Dashboard command → AlphaESS" there too and connect it to the INPUT of the AlphaESS node.
3. Open /dashboard/alphaess.

If you already use Dashboard 2.0: delete the ui-base "AlphaESS" from the config nodes and assign the page "AlphaESS" to your own dashboard (only one ui-base per instance).

SAFETY: write commands only while controls are unlocked (10 min), with two-step confirmation and server-side validation. "Allow write access" must be enabled in the AlphaESS node.

PERSISTENCE: data and 24 h history use the "file" context store (fallback: default store).
